gloss: address on an envelope; inscription on a gift wrapper

definitions.gloss: writing on the front of an envelope or gift wrapping
definitions.explanation: What is written on the front of an envelope (the address and name) or on the paper band or envelope of a gift, such as {御祝|おいわい} or {御礼|おんれい}, which states the purpose of the gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表書|おもてが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I write the address on the front of the envelope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表書|おもてが}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧」にした。
examples.english: On the condolence-money envelope I wrote "For the spirit of the departed."

examples.japanese: {お祝|いわ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品|しな}→品：03192_shina⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}った→合う：10466_au⟧{表書|おもてが}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧のし{紙|がみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけて⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: When sending a gift of congratulations, you have it wrapped in noshi paper with an inscription that fits the occasion.

notes:
Choosing the right {表書|おもてが}き is an important part of Japanese gift etiquette: {御祝|おいわい} for celebrations, ⟦{御礼|おんれい}→御礼：31158_onrei⟧ for thanks, ⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧ or {御香典|ごこうでん} for funerals. Shops that wrap gifts usually ask which one you need.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{封筒|ふうとう}→封筒：02952_fuutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表書|おもてが}き: the writing on the front of an envelope
- のし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表書|おもてが}き: the inscription on a gift's noshi wrapper
- {表書|おもてが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write the inscription or address
